name: Google
description: Google account connection (OAuth). Shared authentication used by Gmail, Calendar, Contacts, Drive and any other Google integration.
long_description:
Connection stub that represents the Google OAuth account. Other extensions declare it as a dependency to signal they need an authenticated Google client (google-sync, a future gmail-sync, calendar-sync, drive, etc.). Installing/removing this extension cleanly gates the entire Google integration surface.

Today the OAuth client + token storage live inside google-sync. A future refactor will hoist auth here so each consumer shares the same refresh-token pool.
author: Kernl
